title: Conduvera WorkContract
description: Canonical work contract for Conduvera operational task payloads. Extracted one-way from the durable task-payload envelope (task-payload.v1, WietRob/conduvera-core). Data shapes only: no runtime state, no execution authority.

payload_id.description: Stable payload identifier of the durable task payload.

schema_version.description: Canonical contract version. task-payload.v1 writers must migrate one-way before emitting a WorkContract.

instructions.description: Exact original task instructions; must never contain secret values.

repo.description: Target repository identity as registered in the canonical repository registry.

base_commit.description: Expected base commit (full SHA-1) of the target repository; empty string when unbound.

secret_refs.description: References to secrets only; secret values are forbidden by contract.

content_sha256.description: Canonical content digest of the envelope (sort_keys, compact separators).

migration_receipt.description: Present only when this contract was produced by the one-way task-payload.v1 migration.

repository_binding.description: Optional registration binding stamped by the preclaim repository guard (e.g. registry name, source snapshot digest).
